## Validation checklist

- [ ] Build/lint/tests run where applicable
- [ ] Synthetic fixture/schema/API contract checks run where applicable

## Security and secrets checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private endpoints, or sensitive data added
- [ ] Authorization is enforced server-side for protected operations
- [ ] Failure and unknown side-effect outcomes are explicit
- [ ] Secrets use approved server-side configuration

## Synthetic-data confirmation

- [ ] Changes use only fictional/synthetic demonstration records
- [ ] Estimates are labelled and are not presented as patient outcomes
- [ ] No real patient, supplier, or customer data is included

## Integration status

- [ ] New or changed integration is labelled verified, proposed, or simulated accurately
- [ ] No live SAP/external connection is claimed without evidence
- [ ] Provider outage, retry, and duplicate-side-effect behavior considered
